csharpCode: public class Script { public static string Main() { var gm=GameManager.Instance; if(gm==null || gm.HQ==null) return "No runtime GameManager/HQ"; var d=HQDepartment.Infirmary; var s=new System.Text.StringBuilder(); s.Append("scene="+UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name+" level="+gm.HQ.GetLevel(d)+" max="+gm.HQ.GetMaxLevel(d)+" prerequisites="+gm.HQ.ArePrerequisitesMet(d)+" unmet="+gm.HQ.GetUnmetReasonText(d)+" canUpgrade="+gm.HQ.CanUpgrade(d)); var costs=gm.HQ.GetUpgradeCost(d,gm.HQ.GetLevel(d)); s.Append(" costTable="+(costs!=null)); if(costs!=null)foreach(var c in costs)s.Append(" cost "+c.Key+"="+c.Value+" affordable="+(gm.Economy!=null&&gm.Economy.Has(c.Key,c.Value))); foreach(var f in LobbyUIRegistry.Facilities)if(f!=null&&f.Department==d)s.Append(" registered=true info=["+f.upgradeInfo+"] desc=["+f.upgradeDesc+"]"); return s.ToString(); } }
